title: Candidates speak out in the races for Madison's City Council
text: The Capital Times invited the candidates in contested races for the Madison City Council to write op-eds making their cases for why voters should choose them in the April 6 election.  The Capital Times invited the candidates in contested races for the Madison City Council to write op-eds making their cases for why voters should choose them in the April 6 election.
